title: Apollo 17 insectoid metallic probe in lunar sky (unreleased)

tellings.quote: If you brighten the image a little bit, you see that it almost looks like an insecttoid type probe like metallic bluish metallic object.

plain: A photo from Apollo 17, the 1972 NASA moon landing with astronauts Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt, shows something in the lunar sky that, once the image is brightened a little, "almost looks like an insectoid type probe," a bluish metallic object. The guest Maaneli Derakhshani describes it himself, from NASA's public archive of Apollo images. If true, it would mean some unknown device was near the astronauts on the Moon.
